segments.ja509:2.1: Cirassaṃ vata passāma, isiṃ dhammaguṇe rataṃ;
segments.ja509:3.1: Āsanaṃ udakaṃ pajjaṃ, paṭigaṇhātu no bhavaṃ;
segments.ja509:3.3: Agghe bhavantaṃ pucchāma, agghaṃ kurutu no bhavaṃ.
segments.ja509:4.1: Adhicca vede pariyesa vittaṃ, putte gahe [gehe (sī. syā. pī.)] tāta patiṭṭhapetvā;
segments.ja509:4.3: Gandhe rase paccanubhuyya [paccanubhotva (syā.), paccanubhutva (pī.)] sabbaṃ, araññaṃ sādhu muni so pasattho.
segments.ja509:5.1: Vedā na saccā na ca vittalābho, na puttalābhena jaraṃ vihanti;
segments.ja509:5.3: Gandhe rase muccana [muñcana (sī. ka.)] māhu santo, sakammunā [sakammanā (sī. pī.)] hoti phalūpapatti.
segments.ja509:6.1: Addhā hi saccaṃ vacanaṃ tavetaṃ, sakammunā hoti phalūpapatti;
segments.ja509:6.3: Jiṇṇā ca mātāpitaro tavīme [taveme (sī.), tava yime (syā. pī.)], passeyyuṃ taṃ vassasataṃ arogaṃ [arogyaṃ (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja509:7.1: Yassassa sakkhī maraṇena rāja, jarāya mettī naravīraseṭṭha;
segments.ja509:7.3: Yo cāpi jaññā na marissaṃ kadāci, passeyyuṃ taṃ vassasataṃ arogaṃ.
segments.ja509:8.1: Yathāpi nāvaṃ puriso dakamhi, ereti ce naṃ upaneti tīraṃ;
segments.ja509:8.3: Evampi byādhī satataṃ jarā ca, upaneti maccaṃ [maccu (syā. pī.)] vasamantakassa.
segments.ja509:9.1: Paṅko ca kāmā palipo ca kāmā, manoharā duttarā maccudheyyā;
segments.ja509:9.3: Etasmiṃ paṅke palipe byasannā [visannā (syā. ka.)], hīnattarūpā na taranti pāraṃ.
segments.ja509:10.1: Ayaṃ pure luddamakāsi kammaṃ, svāyaṃ gahīto na hi mokkhito me;
segments.ja509:10.3: Orundhiyā naṃ parirakkhissāmi, māyaṃ puna luddamakāsi kammaṃ.
segments.ja509:11.1: Gavaṃva [gāvaṃva (sī.)] naṭṭhaṃ puriso yathā vane, anvesatī [pariyesatī (sī. pī.)] rāja apassamāno;
segments.ja509:11.3: Evaṃ naṭṭho esukārī mamattho, sohaṃ kathaṃ na gaveseyyaṃ rāja.
segments.ja509:12.1: Hiyyoti hiyyati [hīyoti hīyati (sī.)] poso, pareti parihāyati;
segments.ja509:12.3: Anāgataṃ netamatthīti ñatvā, uppannachandaṃ ko panudeyya dhīro.
segments.ja509:13.1: Passāmi vohaṃ daharaṃ [daharī (syā. pī. ka.)] kumāriṃ, mattūpamaṃ ketakapupphanettaṃ;
segments.ja509:13.3: Abhuttabhoge [abhutva bhoge (syā. ka. aṭṭha.), abhutva bhoge (pī.), bhoge atutvā (ka.)] paṭhame vayasmiṃ, ādāya maccu vajate kumāriṃ.
segments.ja509:14.1: Yuvā sujāto sumukho sudassano, sāmo kusumbhaparikiṇṇamassu;
segments.ja509:14.3: Hitvāna kāme paṭikacca [paṭigacca (sī.), paṭigaccha (syā. pī.)] gehaṃ, anujāna maṃ pabbajissāmi deva.
segments.ja509:15.1: Sākhāhi rukkho labhate samaññaṃ, pahīnasākhaṃ pana khāṇumāhu;
segments.ja509:15.3: Pahīnaputtassa mamajja bhoti, vāseṭṭhi bhikkhācariyāya kālo.
segments.ja509:16.1: Aghasmi koñcāva yathā himaccaye, katāni [tantāni (sī. pī.)] jālāni padāliya [padāleyya (sī.)] haṃsā;
segments.ja509:16.3: Gacchanti puttā ca patī ca mayhaṃ, sāhaṃ kathaṃ nānuvaje pajānaṃ.
segments.ja509:17.1: Ete bhutvā vamitvā ca, pakkamanti vihaṅgamā;
segments.ja509:17.3: Ye ca bhutvāna vamiṃsu, te me hatthatta [hatthattha (sī. syā. pī.)] māgatā.
segments.ja509:18.1: Avamī brāhmaṇo kāme, so [te (sī. pī.)] tvaṃ paccāvamissasi;
segments.ja509:18.3: Vantādo puriso rāja, na so hoti pasaṃsiyo.
segments.ja509:19.1: Paṅke ca [paṅkeva (sī. pī.)] posaṃ palipe byasannaṃ, balī yathā dubbalamuddhareyya;
segments.ja509:19.3: Evampi maṃ tvaṃ udatāri bhoti, pañcāli gāthāhi subhāsitāhi.
segments.ja509:20.3: Raṭṭhaṃ hitvāna pabbaji, nāgo chetvāva bandhanaṃ.
segments.ja509:21.1: Rājā ca pabbajjamarocayittha, raṭṭhaṃ pahāya naravīraseṭṭho;
segments.ja509:21.3: Tuvampi no hoti yatheva rājā, amhehi guttā anusāsa rajjaṃ.
segments.ja509:22.1: Rājā ca pabbajjamarocayittha, raṭṭhaṃ pahāya naravīraseṭṭho;
segments.ja509:22.3: Ahampi ekā [ekāva (sī.)] carissāmi loke, hitvāna kāmāni manoramāni.
segments.ja509:23.1: Rājā ca pabbajjamarocayittha, raṭṭhaṃ pahāya naravīraseṭṭho;
segments.ja509:23.3: Ahampi ekā carissāmi loke, hitvāna kāmāni yathodhikāni.
segments.ja509:24.1: Accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo, vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti;
segments.ja509:24.3: Ahampi ekā carissāmi loke, hitvāna kāmāni manoramāni.
segments.ja509:25.1: Accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo, vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti;
segments.ja509:25.3: Ahampi ekā carissāmi loke, hitvāna kāmāni yathodhikāni.
segments.ja509:26.1: Accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo, vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti;
segments.ja509:26.3: Ahampi ekā carissāmi loke, sītibhūtā [sītībhūtā (sī.)] sabbamaticca saṅganti.
